pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.4: yath' eva mayaṃ sapajāpatikā āhiṇḍāma, evam ev' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ āhiṇḍantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi . . . paṭipajjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīhi . . . paṭipajjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.14.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantaram pi, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:1.15: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggaṃ paṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.2: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.4: na bhagini kappati bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.5: tumhe vā paṭhamaṃ gacchatha mayaṃ vā gamissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.8: atha kho tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pacchā gacchantīnaṃ antarā magge corā acchindiṃsu ca dūsesuṃ ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.9: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave satthagamanīye magge sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantaraṃ pi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:2.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo: satthagamanīyo hoti maggo sāsaṅkasammato sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.10: gacchāma bhagini gacchām' ayya, gacchām' ayya gacchāma bhagini, ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā gacchāmā 'ti saṃvidahati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.12: kukkuṭasampāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.13: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.17: na sakkā hoti vinā satthena gantuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.19: tasmiṃ magge corānaṃ niviṭṭhokāso dissati bhuttokāso dissati ṭhitokāso dissati nisinnokāso dissati nipannokāso dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.1.21: tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti viluttā dissanti ākoṭitā dissanti. sappaṭibhayaṃ gantvā appaṭibhayaṃ dassitvā uyyojetabbā gacchatha bhaginiyo 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.2.1: saṃvidahite saṃvidahitasaññī ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantaram pi aññatra samayā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc27:3.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati, bhikkhunī na saṃvidahati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
